properties.NAME: JUAB
properties.CHANGE: JUAB exchanged with SANPETE. Boundary between JUAB & SANPETE was "indefinite & ambiguous to the extent that it has been impossible to determine the exact direction of said boundary". This law was an attempt to settle the dispute [see 29 Dec 1916].
properties.CITATION: (Utah Laws 1913, 10th sess., ch. 71, pp. 113-115; HRS Utah, Sanpete, 7-10)
